EarlyResponseDeadline.name: Early Response Deadline
EarlyResponseDeadline.definition: Date/time that the account servicer has set as the deadline to respond, with instructions, to an outstanding event, giving the holder eligibility to incentives.

CoverExpirationDeadline.name: Cover Expiration Deadline
CoverExpirationDeadline.definition: Last day a holder can deliver the securities that it had elected on and/or previously protected.

ProtectDeadline.name: Protect Deadline
ProtectDeadline.definition: Last date/time a holder can request to defer delivery of securities pursuant to a notice of guaranteed delivery or other required documentation.

MarketDeadline.name: Market Deadline
MarketDeadline.definition: Issuer or issuer's agent deadline to respond with an instruction to an outstanding offer or privilege.

ResponseDeadline.name: Response Deadline
ResponseDeadline.definition: Date/time at which the account servicer has set as the deadline to respond, with instructions, to an outstanding event.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date/time at which an order expires or on which a privilege or offer terminates.

SubscriptionCostDebitDate.name: Subscription Cost Debit Date
SubscriptionCostDebitDate.definition: Date/time by which cash must be in place in order to take part in the event.

DepositoryCoverExpirationDate.name: Depository Cover Expiration Date
DepositoryCoverExpirationDate.definition: Last day that a participant of the depository can deliver securities that it had elected on and/or previously protected.

StockLendingDeadline.name: Stock Lending Deadline
StockLendingDeadline.definition: Date/time set as the deadline to respond, with instructions, to an outstanding event, for which the underlying security is out on loan.

BorrowerStockLendingDeadline.name: Borrower Stock Lending Deadline
BorrowerStockLendingDeadline.definition: Specifies the party borrowing stocks and the associated stock lending deadline assigned to the borrower.

DocumentationDeadline.name: Documentation Deadline
DocumentationDeadline.definition: Date/Time by when the documentation must be provided.
